name: Disaster recovery support
description: The goal of Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BCDR) is to ensure uninterrupted access to data and services during data center outages or regional disasters. As we shift towards a self-service SaaS model for our cloud-scale analytics solutions, we understand the need for minimal configuration and planning for critical workloads. In our initial release, we'll provide cross-regional data availability in OneLake if there's a disaster. We also plan to enable capacity-level disaster recovery configuration, allowing you to select replication for essential workspace data while excluding dev and test workspaces.
